note: Both sets are identical except that Set B adds one further claim: the HabEx IFS focal plane's substrate modification (delta doping and a thickened substrate), which is directly supported by the text. All shared claims are correctly bound, with values, units and conditions (e.g., the 10.2" maximum field stop, the 450 nm long-wavelength removal, the ~2% fold-mirror leakage during calibration injection) faithful to the page. Set B therefore captures one more correct engineering fact with no additional errors.
remarks: Both sets omit other notable facts on the page: the calibration source requirement (at least one known wavelength illuminating the entire MLA), the frame-store areas at both sides of the 8k length, readout at high EMCCD gain, and the thruster-firing readout requirement to keep photon count below full well. Minor naming note: the 'guide channel' claims actually describe the Ultraviolet Channel, which is also used as the guide channel for IR science; the binding is defensible but the heading name would be clearer.
